name: Input Buffer Dynamic
description: Input buffering and tap shaping for every gamemode. Press Tab to open the settings.

jump-buffer-ms.name: Cube / Ball / Robot / Spider buffer (ms)
jump-buffer-ms.description: Keeps your input held this long after you let go, so a landing or orb touch inside this window still fires the action.

hold-min-ms.name: Ship / UFO / Swing min hold (ms)
hold-min-ms.description: Stretches taps shorter than this so they still register.

wave-min-hold-ms.name: Wave min hold (ms)
wave-min-hold-ms.description: Minimum time a wave input stays held.

wave-min-gap-ms.name: Wave min gap (ms)
wave-min-gap-ms.description: Minimum time between a wave release and the next press.

grid-snap.name: Grid snap
grid-snap.description: Rounds all delays up to whole physics ticks.

grid-tps.name: Grid TPS
grid-tps.description: Tick rate used by grid snap.
